title: Opioid overdose · Naloxone
sources: NARCAN® Nasal Spray Quick Start Guide

steps.title: Check for a response
steps.text: Shout their name, shake their shoulders, and firmly rub the middle of their chest. Do they respond?

steps.title: Check their breathing
steps.text: Watch their chest for up to 10 seconds. Is their breathing very slow, gasping, or stopped?
steps.speak: Watch their chest for up to ten seconds. Is their breathing very slow, gasping, or stopped?

steps.title: Look at their eyes
steps.text: Are the pupils very small, like pinpoints?

steps.title: Look at their lips
steps.text: Are their lips or fingertips blue or gray?
steps.log: Blue or gray lips or fingertips

steps.title: An overdose is possible
steps.text: Naloxone won't harm someone who hasn't taken opioids. Use the naloxone in your kit?
steps.speak: An overdose is possible. Naloxone won't harm someone who hasn't taken opioids. Use the naloxone in your kit?

variants.title: This looks like a possible opioid overdose
variants.text: Use the naloxone in your kit?
variants.speak: This looks like a possible opioid overdose. Use the naloxone in your kit?

steps.title: Call 911 now
steps.text: Put your phone on speaker and keep going. If they stop breathing, the dispatcher will coach you through CPR.
steps.speak: Call nine one one now. Put your phone on speaker and keep going. If they stop breathing, the dispatcher will coach you through C P R.

steps.title: Open Bay 1
steps.text: Open the red Bay 1 and take out the Narcan nasal spray.
steps.speak: Open the red bay, number one, and take out the Narcan nasal spray.

steps.title: Lay them on their back
steps.text: Lay them flat on their back, face up.

steps.title: Get the spray ready
steps.text: Peel open the package and take out the spray. Hold it with your thumb on the plunger and two fingers on either side of the nozzle.

variants.title: Get a new spray ready
variants.text: Take the second spray from the pack and peel it open. Thumb on the plunger, two fingers on either side of the nozzle.

steps.title: Insert the nozzle
steps.text: Tilt their head back and support their neck with your hand. Gently insert the nozzle into one nostril until your fingers touch the bottom of their nose.
steps.speak: Support their neck with your hand and tilt the head so the chin points up. Gently put the nozzle into one nostril until your fingers touch the bottom of their nose.

variants.title: Use the other nostril
variants.text: Tilt their head back and support their neck with your hand. Insert the new nozzle into the other nostril until your fingers touch the bottom of their nose.
variants.speak: Support their neck and tilt the head so the chin points up. Put the new nozzle into the other nostril until your fingers touch the bottom of their nose.

steps.title: Press the plunger
steps.text: Press the plunger firmly to give the dose. Then say “dose given” or tap the button.
steps.speak: Press the plunger firmly to give the dose, then let me know.

steps.title: Roll them onto their side
steps.text: Put them in the recovery position. Stay with them and watch their breathing.
steps.speak: Roll them onto their side and watch their breathing. Stay with them. I'll check in with you in a couple of minutes.

steps.title: Check on them
steps.text: Are they waking up or breathing normally?

steps.title: Give a second dose
steps.text: They're not responding. Give a second dose with a new spray, in the other nostril.

steps.title: They're responding
steps.text: Keep them on their side and stay with them until EMS arrives. Naloxone can wear off, so keep watching their breathing.

steps.title: No doses left
steps.text: Keep them on their side and follow the 911 dispatcher's instructions until EMS arrives.
steps.speak: That was the last dose in the kit. Keep them on their side and follow the dispatcher until the ambulance arrives.

steps.title: They're responding
steps.text: Stay with them. Call 911 if they get worse or become hard to wake.
steps.speak: Stay with them. Call nine one one if they get worse or become hard to wake.

steps.title: They're breathing
steps.text: Put them on their side, call 911, and keep watching their breathing.
steps.speak: Put them on their side, call nine one one, and keep watching their breathing.

steps.title: Call 911
steps.text: Call 911 and follow the dispatcher's instructions until EMS arrives.
steps.speak: Call nine one one and follow the dispatcher until the ambulance arrives.
